entry.name: Scene
entry.label: Motif / effect scene (chamber = built-in test chamber)

entry.name: FrameRate
entry.label: Animation updates per second (low = less GPU)

entry.name: SceneGlows
entry.label: Core / portal glows of the chosen motif (not for own images)

entry.name: Mirror
entry.label: Mirror the scene horizontally (lettering is mirrored too)

entry.name: Zoom
entry.label: Zoom into the image (1 = fill screen, up to 2)

entry.name: FocusX
entry.label: Horizontal crop position (0 = left, 0.5 = centre, 1 = right)

entry.name: FocusY
entry.label: Vertical crop position (0 = top, 0.5 = centre, 1 = bottom)
